content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the Kashmir University Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 30-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Kashmir University to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Kashmir University for the engagement of Contractual Assistant Professors for the academic session 2026 at the Institute of Technology, Zakura.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name is Contractual Assistant Professor specifically for Computer Science & Engineering under advertisement number F(Advt-Appt-AP-Cont-2026-IOT)DAA/KU/26.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Contractual Assistant Professor position in Computer Science & Engineering at the Institute of Technology, Zakura.

faq.question: Q4. What are the important dates to remember?
faq.answer: The online application process starts on 25 September 2026, and the last date for submitting both the online application form and the hard copy is 30 September 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E/B.Tech and M.E/M.Tech in a relevant branch with a first class in any one of the two degrees, or a Ph.D qualification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: All candidates applying for the Kashmir University Contractual Assistant Professor recruitment are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 250.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The mode of application is online. Candidates must fill out the form online and subsequently submit the hard copy along with relevant documents to the designated office.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the hard copy of the application be submitted?
faq.answer: The hard copy of the downloaded application form along with relevant documents must be submitted in the office of Dean, School of Engineering, Zakura, Srinagar.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Kashmir University Contractual Assistant Professor position involves an Interview of the eligible shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q10. How can I access the official notification and apply?
faq.answer: You can view and download the official notification PDF, apply online, and visit the official website by using the direct links provided in the Important Links section of this article.
